About the Role:

Crusoe is seeking a strategic and self-directed Director, Workforce Housing & Data Center Workplace Operations to lead the development and execution of workforce housing strategy and workplace operations across both remote and non-remote data center sites. As Crusoe continues to scale its data center footprint, this role will be responsible for designing short- and long-term housing solutions where needed, defining what sustainable communities look like in remote environments, and ensuring a consistent, safe, and high-quality workplace experience across all data center locations.

This individual will serve as a key partner to Workplace, People, and Finance leadership, owning the end-to-end strategy and execution of workforce housing and data center workplace programs. Success in this role requires the ability to operate in ambiguity, balance speed with long-term planning, and build scalable models that can be applied consistently across different site types.

This is a full-time position with regular travel required to Crusoe’s data center locations.

What You'll Be Working On:

  • Partner with the Global Director of Workplace to define and execute Crusoe’s workforce housing strategy for remote and non-remote data center locations, including short-term, transitional, and long-term housing solutions where applicable.

  • Lead the planning, development, and rollout of workforce housing programs, evaluating options such as leasing, partnerships, and build-to-suit solutions while balancing cost, speed, risk, and employee experience.

  • Define clear principles for what “community” means in remote environments, including amenities, shared spaces, services, safety considerations, and overall employee experience.

  • Own the Workplace operating model for all data center sites, ensuring consistency, safety, and operational rigor while adapting to site-specific needs.

  • Manage and develop a team of Workplace Site Managers responsible for day-to-day workplace operations at data center locations.

  • Lead workplace readiness for new data center openings and expansions, including service activation, vendor onboarding, and coordination with IT, Security, and Operations.

  • Partner closely with Data Center Operations, Safety, People, Legal, and Finance to ensure housing and workplace solutions are compliant, financially sound, and aligned with workforce needs.

  • Own and manage the Workforce Housing and Data Center Workplace Operations P&L, including annual budgeting, forecasting, and cost controls across housing programs and data center sites. Partner closely with Finance, Workplace, and Data Center leadership to ensure spend aligns with growth plans, operational requirements, and risk management.

  • Identify, onboard, and manage external partners (e.g., housing providers, developers, property managers, service vendors), setting clear expectations and accountability.

  • Establish governance, decision frameworks, and escalation paths to manage risk, scope, and delivery across housing and workplace initiatives.

  • Run retrospectives following launches and major changes to continuously improve housing models, workplace programs, and cross-functional ways of working.

What You'll Bring to the Team:

  • 8–12+ years of experience in workplace operations, real estate, workforce housing, facilities, or operations roles within high-growth, industrial, or distributed environments.

  • Demonstrated experience leading and developing site-based or distributed teams, ideally across multiple locations.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives involving multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.

  • Experience developing and managing housing, facilities, or site-based programs that require balancing cost, speed, safety, and employee experience.

  • Experience working in or supporting a data center environment is a plus.

  • Strong judgment and comfort operating in ambiguity, with the ability to build structure where none exists.

  • Clear and confident communicator, able to align operational teams, external partners, and senior leadership.

  • Willingness to travel regularly to data center sites.

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field preferred.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off & paid holidays

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $182,000 - $228,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicants knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

About This Role:

As an Electrical Engineer II at Crusoe, you'll be a vital contributor to the layout, design, and seamless integration of electrical systems into our custom power and control products for manufacturing. You'll translate customer requirements into tangible electrical design deliverables, meticulously ensure the accuracy of project materials, and actively identify areas for improvement in our manufacturing processes. We're looking for an Electrical Engineer with at least 3-5 years of hands-on experience in a manufacturing, construction, or project environment, who possesses a strong understanding of the National Electrical Code and low-voltage power distribution systems. (#INDMFG)

What You’ll Be Working On:

  • Electrical Design Deliverables: Create precise electrical design deliverables for diverse projects, including one-line diagrams, control schematics, comprehensive submittal packages, and accurate bills of materials.

  • Material Accuracy and Review: Confirm the accuracy of project materials quoted to customers, meticulously reviewing vendor bid packages and submittals for technical precision.

  • Electrical Calculations and Component Sizing: Perform detailed branch circuit and feeder calculations on power distribution equipment, expertly specifying and sizing components to meet design requirements.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with the Production, Procurement, Project Management, and Sales teams to drive continuous improvement opportunities across the product lifecycle.

  • Schematic and Diagram Interpretation: Read, understand, and interpret complex electrical schematics and wiring diagrams.

What You’ll Bring to the Team:

  • Education and Experience: Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related Engineering discipline with a minimum of 3-5 years of experience in a manufacturing, construction, or project environment.

  • NEC Knowledge: Solid knowledge of the National Electrical Code (NEC).

  • Low Voltage Power Distribution Systems: Solid knowledge of the design, building, and maintenance of low voltage (600 volts and below) power distribution systems.

  • Industrial Automation: Solid knowledge of low voltage controls systems, and the ability to specify hardware and components to meet design requirements.

  • Software Proficiency: Solid knowledge of Office-based software and electrical design software (e.g., AutoCAD Electrical, EPLAN) for designing and documenting electrical schematics and power distribution systems.

  • Collaboration Skills: Solid skills in developing and maintaining effective work relationships with production personnel, wiring technicians, and building electricians.

  • Electrical Test Equipment: Solid skills working with, and knowledge of the use of electrical test equipment.

  • Safety and Compliance: This position is designated a safety-sensitive position and/or is located in a safety-sensitive facility. Drug and alcohol program participation is required. Willingness to undergo a background check.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with QA/QC, Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), and comprehensive documentation.

  • Experience with programmable devices in the area of programmable logic controllers (PLCs), motion-control, human-machine interfaces (HMIs), and instrumentation.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off & paid holidays

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

Compensation:

Compensation will be paid in the range of $104,000-$116,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Salary to be determined by the applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

jobs.descriptionHtml:

About This Role:

As the Electrical Engineering Manager at Crusoe, you will lead the high-performing team responsible for transforming complex requirements into the electrical architecture of our modular data centers and power distribution systems. This is a leadership-first role that balances technical authority with organizational strategy.

You will oversee the entire electrical engineering lifecycle—from initial schematic design and UL compliance to final production release—ensuring your team has the resources, standards, and mentorship required to scale. You will be responsible for professional growth, continuous workflow improvement, and the strategic alignment of designs with our vertically integrated manufacturing facility in Arvada.

What You’ll Be Working On:

  • Team Leadership & People Management: Directly manage a team of Electrical Engineers and Designers. Lead regular 1-on-1s, performance reviews, and career development planning to foster a culture of technical rigor and innovation.

  • Resource Allocation: Manage the engineering queue and assign personnel to projects based on expertise and production deadlines, ensuring the manufacturing facility is never bottlenecked.

  • Technical Governance: Lead high-level technical design reviews, serving as the final authority on complex load calculations, project design requirements, control system designs, and Short-Circuit Current Rating (SCCR) analysis.

  • Compliance Authority: Serve as the primary point of contact for UL/NFPA/NEC regulatory bodies, ensuring all product lines (UL 508A, UL 891) maintain their certifications.

  • Design Standards: Establish and enforce "The Crusoe Standard" for electrical documentation, including drawing standardization , BOM accuracy, and wiring methodologies.

  • Workflow Optimization: Identify and implement improvements to the design-to-manufacturing handoff, utilizing ERP/PDM systems to enhance data integrity and speed-to-market.

  • Value Engineering: Lead cross-functional cost-reduction initiatives, working with Procurement and Manufacturing to identify component alternatives that improve margin without sacrificing reliability.

  • Capital & Budget Management: Assist in the development of the annual engineering budget and identify necessary software, hardware, or third-party consulting needs.

What You’ll Bring to the Team:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering. A Master’s degree or Professional Engineer (PE) license is highly preferred.

  • Leadership Experience: Minimum of 3–5 years in a formal management or supervisory role, leading multidisciplinary or specialized electrical teams.

  • Technical Foundation: 10+ years of total experience in electrical design, specifically within power distribution, switchgear, or modular industrial buildings.

  • Systemic Thinking: Proven ability to manage a department-level "engine," balancing long-term process improvements with the day-to-day demands of a fast-paced manufacturing shop.

  • Communication: Exceptional ability to translate complex technical challenges into actionable business insights for executive leadership.

  • Safety and Compliance: This position is designated a safety-sensitive position and/or is located in a safety-sensitive facility. Drug and alcohol program participation is required.

Bonus Points:

  • Lean Manufacturing: Experience applying Lean or Six Sigma principles to an engineering design environment.

  • Advanced Systems: Deep familiarity with PLC/SCADA integration and medium-voltage power distribution.

  • Scale: Experience growing an engineering team from a small group to a mid-sized department during a period of rapid growth.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off & paid holidays

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

Compensation

Compensation will be paid in the range of $141,750 - $162,000 + Bonus. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

jobs.title: Staff Infrastructure Security Engineer (Generalist)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

About This Role

Crusoe’s mission is to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. We’re seeking a Staff Infrastructure Security Engineer to secure the foundations of Crusoe Cloud, our purpose-built compute platform for AI and high-performance workloads. This role focuses on designing and embedding security controls directly into our global infrastructure, enabling customers to train advanced models within a trusted, secure-by-default environment.

You’ll operate at the intersection of infrastructure, security, and reliability; architecting identity, network, and cloud security systems that scale with a high-growth cloud provider.

What You’ll Be Working On

  • Architecting security controls across compute, networking, and storage layers of a global cloud platform

  • Championing Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) standards (e.g., Terraform) to enforce secure defaults, immutability, and drift detection

  • Building automated security guardrails embedded directly into CI/CD and deployment pipelines

  • Collaborating on a centralized Vault-as-a-Platform service to manage secrets, encryption keys, and internal PKI

  • Designing and operating certificate lifecycles (X.509, SSH) to support secure machine-to-machine trust

  • Driving adoption of short-lived, Just-In-Time (JIT) access models to reduce standing privileges and improve auditability

  • Securing core network foundations, including global DNS architecture, service discovery, and network authentication systems

  • Designing and maintaining authentication controls for network infrastructure to ensure secure, monitored access

  • Partnering closely with infrastructure, platform, and SRE teams to identify and remediate security gaps in foundational systems


What You’ll Bring to the Team

  • 8+ years of hands-on experience in infrastructure engineering, SRE, or security engineering

  • Deep understanding of security principles across the stack, from Linux and container runtimes to cloud control planes

  • Proven experience using Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform) to manage complex, multi-environment infrastructure at scale

  • Strong knowledge of cryptography, secrets management, PKI, and modern authentication standards

  • Experience securing public cloud (AWS, GCP) and/or bare-metal environments

  • Strong networking fundamentals, including routing, segmentation, firewalls, and Zero Trust architectures

  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and container security, including secure secrets injection into microservices

  • Fluency in at least one programming language (Go or Python preferred) for automation and tooling

Bonus Points

  • Experience building or operating internal security platforms (e.g., Vault-as-a-Service)

  • Background securing high-scale cloud or AI infrastructure

  • Experience implementing Zero Trust identity architectures end-to-end

  • Familiarity with bare-metal provisioning and data center security considerations

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off & paid holidays

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $210,000 - $265,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicants knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

About This Role

We’re seeking an Atlassian Cloud Engineer to serve as the primary administrator and strategic owner of our Atlassian ecosystem. This role blends deep technical expertise with strong project management instincts to ensure Jira, Confluence, and related tools are optimized for collaboration, delivery, and service management. You’ll act as both platform owner and change agent driving innovation, best practices, and adoption as the business scales.

What You’ll Be Working On

  • Owning day-to-day administration and long-term strategy for the Atlassian suite, including Jira Software, Jira Service Management, Confluence, Opsgenie, Product Discovery, and Statuspage

  • Customizing workflows, permissions, dashboards, and automation to improve project execution, visibility, and cross-team collaboration

  • Partnering with project managers, business leaders, and IT teams to embed effective project management and ITSM practices within Atlassian tools

  • Designing advanced reporting and analytics using eazyBI, JQL, filters, CQL, and dashboards to support real-time decision-making

  • Acting as the escalation point for complex platform issues, working closely with Atlassian Support and internal Service Desk teams

  • Leading platform enhancements by staying ahead of Atlassian’s roadmap and championing adoption of new features

  • Driving AI initiatives within the Atlassian ecosystem, including building custom agents using Atlassian Rovo and implementing the Rovo MCP server

  • Collaborating across IT to ensure reliability, security, and alignment with broader business objectives

What You’ll Bring to the Team

  • 3+ years of experience administering Atlassian Cloud environments in enterprise settings

  • Proven ownership of Jira and Confluence customization, site administration, and day-to-day operations

  • Advanced expertise in Jira project configuration, including workflows, permission schemes, issue security, issue types, field configurations, and project roles

  • Strong command of Jira Query Language (JQL), Confluence Query Language (CQL), and eazyBI for advanced reporting

  • Experience implementing and operating ITSM processes in Jira Service Management (Incident, Change, Problem, CMDB/Assets)

  • Solid understanding of RBAC, change control, release management, and system administration best practices

  • Experience configuring authentication and authorization with Okta or similar IAM providers

  • Familiarity integrating Atlassian tools with other business systems and working with structured data formats (JSON, YAML)

Bonus Points

  • Atlassian Cloud Professional certifications (ACP), with 2+ preferred

  • Experience leading AI-driven initiatives within Atlassian, including Rovo agent development

  • Background managing large-scale Atlassian implementations or migrations

  • Experience supporting external user access and complex security models

  • Prior work in fast-growing or highly cross-functional organizations

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off & paid holidays

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off


Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $115,000 - $135,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicants knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. About This Role:

We’re seeking a Senior API Integration Engineer to serve as a strategic technical partner driving enterprise-wide digital transformation through intelligent automation and scalable system integrations. This role will lead the design and delivery of mission-critical integrations across our People Tech ecosystem, with a strong emphasis on Workday HCM, while setting integration standards, mentoring engineers, and partnering closely with business leaders to modernize workflows at scale.

What You’ll Be Working On:

  • Architecting and building enterprise-grade integrations using the Workato ONE platform to enable intelligent workflow automation

  • Designing, developing, and maintaining deep API integrations across Workday HCM and the broader People Tech stack (payroll, ATS, LMS, compensation, benefits, performance, analytics)

  • Leveraging AI-powered automation within Workato to improve efficiency, resiliency, and predictive process optimization

  • Establishing reusable integration architecture patterns, frameworks, and governance standards that scale across both human-led and automated workflows

  • Partnering with business and IT stakeholders to gather requirements, lead discovery sessions, assess ROI, and translate complex needs into scalable technical solutions

  • Leading integration initiatives end-to-end, from concept through deployment, including sprint execution, technical reviews, and delivery accountability

  • Providing senior-level escalation support, ensuring reliability, monitoring, alerting, and incident response for critical integrations


What You’ll Bring to the Team:

  • 7+ years of experience as an API Developer or Integration Engineer in enterprise environments

  • 3+ years of hands-on production experience with Workato, ideally with Workato ONE

  • Deep expertise building and operating complex Workato recipes, including error handling, monitoring, batch processing, custom connectors, SDK development, and API collections

  • Interest in and exposure to AI-assisted development workflows and intelligent automation — you don't need to be an expert, but you should be excited about where integration engineering is heading

  • Collaborating with internal software engineering teams to ensure integration patterns and API access are available for custom-built internal tools and automations

  • Proven experience integrating Workday HCM (Core HCM, Recruiting, Talent, Compensation, Time, Absence, Benefits)

  • Strong background integrating People Tech platforms across payroll, ATS, LMS, compensation, performance, and benefits systems

  • Expert knowledge of enterprise integration best practices, EAI/SOA patterns, and iPaaS architectures

  • Proficiency with RESTful APIs, webhooks, JSON/XML, OAuth 2.0, SAML, SOAP, RBAC, and API security best practices

  • Experience with Agile/Scrum delivery, Jira/JSM, Confluence, and CI/CD workflows

  • Strong understanding of HR data models, compliance requirements (e.g., GDPR, SOC 2), and secure handling of sensitive PII

Bonus Points

  • Workato Foundations or Integration Developer certifications

  • Workday certifications or experience with Workday Studio, EIB, and Web Services

  • Experience with additional iPaaS platforms (e.g., MuleSoft, Boomi, Informatica)

  • Background in HR technology consulting or HRIS implementations

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), IaC tools, or identity and SSO integrations

  • Experience in high-growth or highly regulated environments

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off & paid holidays

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off


Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $165,000 - $200,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicants knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

jobs.descriptionHtml:

As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

About This Role

We’re seeking a Manager, Service Desk to lead and evolve Crusoe’s Service Desk function. This role is designed for a customer-obsessed, data-driven leader who excels at building repeatable, secure, and scalable service operations. You’ll be responsible for developing the team, maturing service delivery processes, and ensuring the Service Desk operates as a trusted partner to the business, not just a support queue.

As the function scales, you’ll transition from hands-on troubleshooting to strategic oversight, owning sensitive workflows, high-visibility projects, and operational excellence that directly support Crusoe’s mission.

What You’ll Be Working On

  • Leading, mentoring, and developing a team of Service Desk Technicians through structured coaching, delegation, and knowledge transfer

  • Designing and operating scalable, repeatable processes for user provisioning, offboarding, incident management, and request fulfillment

  • Using ticketing data and KPIs (NPS, CSAT, resolution time, SLA adherence) to identify trends, eliminate root causes, and report on team health

  • Acting as a primary stakeholder for IT security operations, including access audits, termination workflows, and security protocol enforcement

  • Leading cross-functional projects such as office expansions, hardware lifecycle refreshes, and SaaS migrations

  • Serving as a trusted escalation point for complex user issues and ensuring a consistent “white-glove” service experience

What You’ll Bring to the Team

  • 5+ years of experience in a Service Desk leadership or lead role, with demonstrated success managing teams and outcomes

  • Strong customer service instincts with the ability to balance empathy, clarity, and operational discipline

  • Proven experience using data and metrics to drive continuous improvement and executive-level reporting

  • Expertise building and maintaining service metrics dashboards (queue health, SLA performance, CSAT, deflection, documentation quality)

  • Advanced administration experience with Google Workspace and Okta, including lifecycle management and security auditing

  • Solid understanding of endpoint management (Jamf, Intune), MDR/XDR platforms, and networking fundamentals


Bonus Points

  • Experience automating Service Desk workflows using Python, Bash, or low-/no-code tools (e.g., Workato, Okta Workflows)

  • Background supporting NOC/SOC operations or physical office/data center expansions

  • Strategic mindset with experience building long-term Service Desk roadmaps

  • Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or equivalent experience

  • 8+ years of experience in IT systems or enterprise support environments


Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off & paid holidays

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

About the Role:

Join Crusoe’s Finance team, playing a key role in supporting our dynamic, growing digital infrastructure business, including pipeline projects and operational assets. You will be responsible for financial planning, forecasting, budgeting, and performance measurement, with a specific focus on AI-driven data center infrastructure. The Senior Financial Analyst role is expected to make significant contributions to enable senior leaders and executives to make business decisions, and will also provide crucial support on the Digital Infrastructure deal side. We're seeking a results-driven professional with 3-6 years of experience in FP&A. Experience in real estate or infrastructure development projects is a plus. Strong financial modeling skills are required. This role is required to be in office 5 days per week.

What You'll Be Working On:

  • Budgeting & Forecasting: Partner with Finance and relevant stakeholders to create capital budgets for data center projects. Prepare the annual budget and monthly forecasts (at both the consolidated and project levels), ensuring timely tracking, performance analysis, and communications.

  • Board Materials and Executive Reporting: Create and deliver monthly and quarterly executive reports, funding requests, board materials, and investor updates.

  • Financial Analysis: Build financial models to lead cost analysis and continuously monitor financial performance to identify risks and opportunities for profitability & cash flow profile improvements, among other insights

  • Capital Raise Support: Support the strategic finance team with the creation of models, presentations, and diligence materials for fundraising events, including equity and debt.

  • Cross-Department Collaboration: Act as connective tissue between digital infrastructure business teams & leadership to shape financial decisions, drive thoughtful analysis, identify trends, and offer actionable recommendations

  • Process Improvement: Improve and/or identify tools to streamline planning and reporting processes, create dashboard metrics for internal and external stakeholders

What You'll Bring to the Team:

  • Experience & Education: 3-6 years of FP&A, corporate finance experience across real estate, industrial, energy, or infrastructure. Bachelor's Degree is required, MBA a plus.

  • Financial Expertise: Advanced skills in financial modeling & analyses, forecasting, budgeting, scenario analyses, and solid understanding of key financial concepts such as three statements, return metrics such as IRR and MOIC, EBIT and NOI.

  • Deal Support: Proven experience in supporting complex financial deals.

  • Process Improvement: Proven ability to drive process enhancements and improve reporting accuracy.

  • Work Ethic: Capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment with a sense of urgency, while maintaining high-quality output under pressure.

  • Personal Attributes: Self-driven, proactive, and committed to excellence. High degree of professionalism, intellectual curiosity, and ability to manage multiple projects and work effectively under tight deadlines.

  • Collaboration: Exceptional communication and collaboration skills across teams and departments.

  • Solution oriented: Relentlessly identify, propose, and implement opportunities

  • Company Values: Embody the Company values.

Bonus Points

  • Strong sector experience or knowledge within Data Centers, Real Estate, Energy, and/or Infrastructure

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off & paid holidays

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

Compensation:

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $150,975 - $183,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant’s knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. About This Role:

We are seeking a highly experienced and knowledgeable Employee Relations Manager to join our growing team, based in our Dublin office. This is a critical global role responsible for managing and resolving complex employee success matters, ensuring compliance with local labor laws, and fostering a positive and productive work environment across our key international markets. You will serve as the primary ER expert for our operations in Israel, Iceland, and Norway, while also acting as a core generalist HR partner.

This is a fully onsite position, requiring five days a week at our Dublin, IE office.

What You'll Be Working On:

  • Employee Relations Management: Lead and manage the full spectrum of employee relation issues, including complex disciplinary matters, grievances, performance management, internal investigations, and conflict resolution across Israel, Iceland, and Norway.

  • Global Compliance: Serve as the subject matter expert on employment law and HR practices for the supported countries (Israel, Iceland, and Norway). Ensure all ER policies and practices are locally compliant and aligned with global standards.

  • Strategic Partnership: Collaborate closely with the Employee Success Team in the US to ensure consistency in performance management, policy application, and overall employee experience across the supported regions.

  • HR Generalist Support: Leverage strong generalist HR knowledge to advise and support local leadership and HR colleagues on broader HR initiatives, including policy development, training, and change management.

  • Investigations: Conduct thorough, impartial, and confidential investigations into workplace complaints, harassment, and discrimination allegations, providing clear documentation and recommended outcomes.

  • Case Management: Maintain accurate, confidential case management records using ER case management tools, ensuring data integrity and audit-readiness.

  • Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify emerging ER risks and trends across supported regions, recommending preventative measures to reduce organizational exposure.

What You'll Bring to the Team:

  • Experience: 10+ years of progressive experience in employee success, Human Resources, or a related field, with a significant focus on complex cross-border or international ER matters.

  • Employment Law Expertise: Demonstrable strong knowledge of employment law and regulatory environments, particularly within EMEA/international jurisdictions. Specific experience with labor laws in Israel, Iceland, and Norway is highly desirable.

  • HR Generalist Acumen: Strong generalist HR knowledge, including experience with performance management, compensation, benefits, and talent management principles.

  • Interpersonal Skills: Exceptional communication, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills, with the ability to influence and build trust with stakeholders at all levels and across diverse cultures.

  • Travel: Willingness to travel periodically as needed; 25%

  • Location: Must be based in Dublin, Ireland.

Bonus:

  • Must be able to pass a background check

  • Embody the Company values

Benefits: 

  • Competitive Paid Time Off

  • Industry competitive pay

  • Retirement benefits

  • Healthcare benefits including Medical, Dental, and Vision

  • Short and Long-Term Disability Insurance

  • Life Insurance

  • Paid Parental Leave

  • Subscription to Calm App

Compensation Range:

Compensation will be paid as salary or hourly. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

About the Role:

We are looking for a Senior Recruiting Operations Analyst to join our growing Recruiting Ops organization. This role is critical to maximizing the effectiveness and efficiency of our recruiting ops function focusing on Recruiting tools and operational hygiene. You'll be the expert ensuring our systems drive both efficiency and data-driven decision making across the entire recruitment lifecycle.

This is a fully onsite position, requiring five days a week at our San Francisco, CA office.

What You'll Be Working On:

  • Responsible for system administration, troubleshooting, and supporting process improvements across our recruiting platforms.

  • Drive recruiting excellence through technology ensuring we are using the right tools, implementing the best processes, and making data informed decisions

  • Serve as subject matter expert and system administrator for Ashby (ATS) and TeamOhana (Headcount Management Tool)

  • Own configurations, workflow management, permissioning, troubleshooting, user support, and regular system audits

  • Analyze and refine TA processes through deep system and data analysis to increase recruiter productivity, candidate experience, and hiring manager satisfaction

  • Assist in the rollout of new features, enhancements, and system updates across Recruiting platforms

  • Ensure data integrity and compliance with all relevant regulations (e.g., EEO, OFCCP, GDPR), manage audits, and implement best practices for managing sensitive candidate data

What You'll Bring to the Team:

  • Bachelor's degree in HR, Information Systems, Business, Data Analytics, or related field, or equivalent experience

  • Ashby ATS experience or equivalent

  • 3+ years working directly with Recruiting systems as an analyst, administrator

  • Deep understanding of modern end-to-end recruiting processes and systems

  • Experience with systems integration, API utilization, and data flow mapping across

  • Excellent communication skills; able to translate technical issues for non-technical audiences and vice versa

  • Committed to high standards of accuracy, data privacy, and ethical handling of information

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off & paid holidays

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $103,000 - $126,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicants knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

About the Role:

We are looking for an on-site strategic and execution-focused Senior Program Manager, Recruiting Enablement to lead the development, optimization, and implementation of hiring programs at Crusoe. This role will be instrumental in composing scalable infrastructure, improving candidate experience, and enabling data-driven decision-making across our Recruiting function. The ideal candidate will also play a meaningful role in supporting enterprise-wide change initiatives, ensuring seamless adoption and integration across teams.

This is a fully onsite position, requiring five days a week at either our San Francisco, CA or Bellevue, WA office.

What You'll Be Working On:

  • Partner closely with Recruiting leaders and business partners to identify opportunities to enhance how talent systems support strategic and operational objectives across sourcing, recruiting, interviewing, and hiring

  • Develop Recruiting systems training, conduct onboarding for new users, create job aids/documentation, and drive user adoption for new features

  • Assess new systems or enhancements, lead pilots or rollouts, and ensure alignment with business needs

  • Act as a subject matter expert for AI-driven recruitment solutions by evaluating, implementing and maintaining automation tools

  • Oversee Recruiting vendor relationships, leading the discovery, implementation, and administration of systems to enhance global hiring capabilities

  • Champion data-driven decision making by advancing the use of recruiting analytics and partnering with Recruiting to define key metrics of success, including overseeing data integrity, establishing quality control frameworks and leading audit projects

  • Identify and execute large-scale transformation initiatives that improve efficiency and consistency across the entire recruitment lifecycle

  • Translate business needs into system and workflow requirements and ensure new processes are adopted smoothly by recruiters, hiring managers, and coordinators

  • Support enterprise-wide changes affecting hiring. Lead change strategies including stakeholder engagement, communications, training, and feedback. Track adoption and improve based on results.

What You'll Bring to the Team:

  • 5+ years in Recruiting Operations or HR program management in a fast paced environment

  • Proven success leading cross-functional programs and driving adoption

  • Managed and owned full cycle project management with established workflows, user acceptance testing, communications and launch plans

  • Strong communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences and seniority levels

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and change

  • Experience navigating global hiring regulations, data privacy, and AI compliance is a plus

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off & paid holidays

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $103,950 - $126,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicants knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

About the Role:

We're seeking an enthusiastic Director of Employee Success to join our dynamic People Team at Crusoe Energy. In this pivotal role, you'll drive the agenda of Crusoe Energy's People Team, forming strong partnerships with fellow People Team members, employees, and leaders at all levels to guide and implement effective people strategies. Your responsibilities will include organizational development, change management and fostering employee growth, mobility and engagement. This role will be focused on our Real Estate Team, which focuses on the development of our data centers, and is one of the fastest growing organizations at Crusoe! You'll contribute to the refinement and execution of the Real Estate team that enhance organizational functionality, employee development, team member retention, and overall company performance while supporting Crusoe Energy's growth trajectory.

This is a fully onsite position, requiring five days a week at our San Francisco, CA office.

What You'll Be Working On:

  • Partner with People Team Leaders and Leadership to create pragmatic, strategy aligned HR strategies and programs; including performance management, management excellence programs, and compensation reviews

  • Develop and implement programs that will drive positive change and impact

  • Guide managers on career pathing and leveling, skill and professional development

  • Serve as a point of contact for employees; helping them navigate professional or personal issues that impact their work and career growth

  • Collaborate across peer groups to meet business needs

  • Lead day-to-day activities related to HR policies, processes, and programs

  • Track and analyze key indicators of organizational health and recommend ways to improve value through pulse surveys, or other tools

  • Drive initiatives to foster employee engagement, improve retention rates, and enhance overall job satisfaction

  • Proactively strive to maintain a positive work environment that respects and supports inclusion, diversity, employee morale and overall well-being

  • Conduct organizational assessments, talent gap analyses, and structure recommendations to align business strategy with HR initiatives

  • Facilitate off-boarding for voluntary and involuntary terminations, when necessary

What You'll Bring to the Team:

  • 10+ years of experience working as an Employee Business Partner with an ability to foster positive relationships between employees and an organization resulting in evidence of favorable outcomes

  • Ability to travel about 30% of the time

  • You have specific experience working with software, data center, and real estate populations.

  • You have experience working with employees globally

  • You have proven ability to leverage deep understanding of the business strategy, plan, and value creation levers to provide insight and leadership into organizational effectiveness, talent planning, and talent development

  • You have proven ability to leverage data of many forms to drive actionable insights and demonstrable impact

  • You are comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with ambiguous and/or iterative fact-sets, decisioning

  • You are highly organized, process-oriented, excellent follow-through and reliable - nobody ever questions if you'll do what you say you're going to do. You communicate status updates regularly to build trust with colleagues and leaders

  • You have the ability to take initiative and work autonomously – and can conceive, develop and project manage key work from beginning to end

  • You demonstrate a high level of discretion when dealing with confidential and sensitive matters

  • You have proven expertise in consultation, investigations, guidance, policy development, and coaching to managers to address sensitive and/or difficult employee behavior and performance concerns

  • You have the proven ability to establish influential partnerships working with peers and leaders at all levels and across organizational lines to provide effective and strategic employee relations counsel

  • You have an aptitude for staying informed of the latest HR trends to offer progressive and relevant solutions

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off & paid holidays

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $191,000 - $239,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicants knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

jobs.title: Material Handler
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

As a Material Handler at Crusoe's Tulsa facility, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the smooth and efficient flow of materials that support our cutting-edge data center construction business. You'll be responsible for the precise handling, movement, and preparation of materials within our plant, contributing directly to our production goals and maintaining a safe and organized work environment. This is a hands-on position vital to our operational success. This is a full-time position.

Hours: 1st shift: Monday - Thursday 6am - 4:30pm

What You'll Be Working On

  • Material Movement & Kitting: Load, unload, kit, and move materials within the plant, yard, or designated work sites. You will convey materials from storage areas to their designated locations efficiently.

  • Forklift & Crane Operation: Operate industrial forklifts and/or overhead cranes as needed to assist in loading, unloading, and moving materials and products. You will also securely attach lifting attachments to units and effectively signal crane operators to safely move loads.

  • Packaging & Labeling: Read Bills of Material or follow oral instructions to accurately identify and prepare materials for production or shipment. You will package parts diligently, attach identifying tags or labels, and assemble crates to contain and protect products.

  • Safety & Organization: Lift heavy objects by hand or with power hoists, adhering to all safety protocols. You will also maintain a clean and organized work area, including machines and equipment, to support a safe and productive environment.

What You'll Bring to the Team

  • Material Handling Experience: Proven ability to safely load, unload, and move materials within a manufacturing or warehouse environment.

  • Documentation & Detail Orientation: The ability to read and interpret Bills of Material or accurately follow oral instructions, with a strong attention to detail for accurate labeling and marking.

  • Equipment Operation: Demonstrated proficiency in operating industrial forklifts. Experience with overhead cranes is also preferred.

  • Work Ethic & Collaboration: Regular attendance and punctuality are a must. You will have a strong ability to work cooperatively with others and thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

  • Safety & Physical Requirements: You will be capable of lifting heavy objects by hand or using power hoists safely. The role requires the ability to lift, lower, push, and pull merchandise up to 50 lbs, as well as the ability to stand, walk, stoop, and bend for 8 or more hours daily.

  • Communication Skills: Effective communication skills to interchange seamlessly with others in the department.

Bonus Points

  • Computer skills to cross-train and support various functions within the shipping and warehouse departments.

  • Experience with safety protocols in a manufacturing or industrial setting.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off & paid holidays

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

Compensation

Compensation will be paid in the range of $19.50 - $24.00/Hr + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

jobs.title: Senior Cloud Support Engineer, Tuesday - Saturday
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

About This role:

Crusoe Cloud is revolutionizing high-performance computing by offering sustainable, low-cost GPU compute power. As a Cloud Support Engineer, you'll play a crucial role in empowering our customers to leverage this technology for groundbreaking advancements in fields like AI/ML, physics simulations, and computational biology. You will be the primary point of contact for technical support, ensuring our customers can seamlessly utilize Crusoe Cloud to achieve their goals. This role directly impacts Crusoe's mission by enabling our customers to accelerate their research and development, contributing to a more sustainable future. You will be involved in exciting projects, working with cutting-edge technologies and collaborating with a talented team to solve complex challenges. The ideal candidate is a highly motivated and experienced technical professional with a passion for customer success, a deep understanding of cloud technologies, and a commitment to Crusoe's values. This is a full-time position.

What You’ll Be Working On:

  • Tuesday - Saturday Shift Pattern. Tuesday - Friday on site - Saturday Remote.

  • Customer Support: Provide exceptional technical support to customers via Zendesk, meeting SLAs and maintaining high CSAT (95%+).

  • On-Call Rotation: Participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation to ensure timely resolution of critical issues.

  • Incident Management: Primary point of contact for incident management, focusing on initial triage, communication, and procedural rigor throughout the incident lifecycle. You'll lead response efforts, ensuring clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and acting as a customer advocate to minimize disruption.

  • Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve issues related to VMs, hardware failures, and scaling tests using CLI and internal tools.

  • Alert Triage and Maintenance: Manage alert triage, prepare for maintenance windows, and conduct node delivery testing.

  • Collaboration: Work closely with SRE, Networking, and Storage teams from initial triage to root cause analysis (RCA) delivery.

  • Global Teamwork: Adhere to global team collaboration and handoff processes for ticketing and on-call procedures.

  • Knowledge Sharing: Develop onboarding/training materials, knowledge base documentation, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).

What You’ll Bring to the Team:

  • Education/Experience: Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or 4+ years of equivalent technical experience.

  • Linux Proficiency: Strong command-line interface (CLI) skills in Linux environments.

  • Version Control: Proficiency with Git for code management and collaboration.

  • Customer Support Experience: 5+ years of experience in a customer support role, ideally within cloud, storage, or networking environments.

  • Cloud Technologies: Experience with container orchestration (e.g., Kubernetes), workload management (e.g., Slurm, Terraform), and monitoring tools (e.g., Grafana).

  • Public Cloud Knowledge: Familiarity with other public cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP).

  • Communication Skills: Excellent communication and customer service skills, including the ability to prioritize competing escalations.

  • HPC Knowledge: Understanding of HPC technologies such as Infiniband, RDMA, RoCE, and Software Defined Networking (SDN).

Bonus Points:

  • Certifications: CKA, CKAD, CKS, KCNA, AWS Machine Learning - Specialty, Data Analytics - Specialty, Solutions Architect - Professional, Developer - Associate, NVIDIA AI Infrastructure and Operations, Generative AI and LLMs, Generative AI Multi-modal, Infiniband, Linux Foundation IT Associate, System Administrator.

  • Cloud Expertise: Deep understanding of specific cloud platforms and services.

  • Automation Skills: Experience with automation tools and scripting languages.

  • Problem-Solving Abilities: Demonstrated ability to analyze complex technical issues and develop effective solutions.

  • Collaboration and Mentorship: Proven ability to mentor, train, and onboard colleagues.

  • Passion for Sustainability: A strong interest in contributing to a more sustainable future through technology.

Benefits:

Crusoe offers a competitive benefits package designed to support financial security, health, and overall well-being, including pension contributions, private health and dental insurance, income protection, life assurance and more.

Compensation:

Compensation will be paid as salary or hourly. Compensation to be determined by the applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

jobs.title: Manager, Field Operations (Modular Data Centers)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

About the Role:

Once a Spark (Modular Data Center) is deployed, it must stay up. We are seeking a Manager, Field Ops to build the operational capability for maintaining a geodiverse fleet of high-density Spark AI data centers. You are the leader who ensures that our assets perform with Tier 3 reliability.

What You'll Be Working On:

I. Fleet Operations & Uptime

  • Availability Management: Accountable for "Uptime" and "Time to Repair" metrics across the Spark fleet. Develop the “playbook” and SOPs to ensure that each Spark unit is deployed, powered & commissioned successfully.

  • Maintenance Scheduling: Create and own the maintenance and SOPs playbook of deployed Spark units. Develop and oversee preventative maintenance for electrical distribution, HVAC, and fire suppression systems.

  • SLA Enforcement: Ensure our managed services customers receive the reliability and performance guaranteed in our service agreements.

  • DIG & Spark Interface: Act as the Spark field operations interface with Crusoe’s DIG team, to incorporate DIG best practices and standardize Spark operations and drive alignment with DIG to simplify operations and maintenance protocols across Spark deployments.

II. Liquid Cooling Maintenance Transition

  • Standard Ops: Lead, and standardize the operational playbook for all air-cooled Spark units to ensure up time and meet Cloud/Product team SLA requirements.

  • CDU/DLC Ops: Lead the operational readiness for maintaining liquid-cooled infrastructure (CDUs, cooling loops, leak detection).

  • Technical Training: Standardize the training protocols for field technicians to handle next-gen Spark units and GPU clusters.

III. Logistics & Safety SOPs

  • Sparing Strategy: Build a standardized logistics plan for critical spares to ensure 4-hour response times at remote sites.

  • Staffing Strategy: Build a standardized staffing strategy for maintaining, operating and addressing SLA needs for 4-hour response times at remote sites.

  • Mountaineer Safety: Implement rigorous OSHA and LOTO (Lockout-Tagout) protocols across all field work to ensure a zero-incident culture.

What You'll Bring to the Team:

  • Mission Critical Leadership: 10+ years of experience in data center operations or high-stakes field services.

  • Technical Troubleshooting: Hands-on expertise with industrial equipment (UPS, transformers) and a clear roadmap for maintaining liquid-cooled (DLC) systems.

  • Remote Fleet Management: Experience managing "lights-out" or unmanned facilities across a broad geographic footprint.

  • Sourcing & Logistics: Ability to build a global sparing strategy; you know what needs to be in a "crash kit" to hit a 4-hour SLA.

  • Safety Mastery: Expert knowledge of OSHA standards and LOTO protocols for high-voltage and mission-critical systems.

  • Process Discipline: A gift for writing clear, actionable SOPs and Emergency Operating Procedures (EOPs) that ensure "Mountaineer" level safety.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off & paid holidays

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $140,250 - $170,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicants knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

About the Role:

Crusoe.ai is looking for a Web Marketing Manager to serve as the strategic and analytical engine of our digital presence. This role is designed for a data-first marketer who thrives at the intersection of Organic Discovery (SEO/AEO) and Performance Analytics. Your mission is to maximize Crusoe's visibility in search and AI engines while building the data infrastructure that proves the business impact of our web initiatives. You will not just report on trends; you will turn search data into actionable roadmaps that steer our content, campaigns, and product direction.

What You'll Be Working On:

  • SEO & AEO Technical Ownership:

    • Own the technical SEO/AEO roadmap, focusing on site architecture, advanced schema markup, and citability by AI engines (with a hyperfocus on increasing impressions and average position for non-branded terms).

    • Monitor and optimize Crusoe’s presence in generative search (Perplexity, ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) to ensure our core narratives are captured accurately by LLMs.

    • Conduct deep-dive competitive analysis to identify organic "white space" opportunities in the AI and infrastructure sectors.

  • Data Infrastructure & Insights:

    • Own the web data stack by ensuring Google Analytics 4, Search Console, and SEO tools are properly configured, integrated, and serving as a single source of truth.

    • Build and maintain automated dashboards that visualize site health, conversions, and granular ranking trends for high-intent non-branded clusters.

  • Insight-to-Action:

    • Influence Strategy: Regularly present search data to the broader marketing team to identify emerging trends and steer the content calendar.

    • Optimize Efficiency: Partner with the Demand Gen team to align paid and organic strategies, using SEO data to improve campaign relevance and reduce dependency on paid terms.

    • Consult for Product Marketing: Advocate for data-backed feature naming, technical documentation, and product-led content based on how users actually search for solutions.

    • Drive Engineering: Translate data-backed optimizations into high-priority technical requirements for the web engineering backlog, ensuring SEO is a cornerstone of every site sprint.

What You'll Bring to the Team:

  • Experience: 4+ years in a technical SEO or Web Marketing Analytics role, ideally in-house at a B2B tech or AI company.

  • Data Mastery: Expert-level knowledge of GA4, GTM (Google Tag Manager), and SEO platforms (e.g., SEMrush, Ahrefs, or Botify). You have the ability to visualize complex datasets in Looker Studio to drive executive decision-making.

  • Technical Depth: A deep understanding of how crawlers and LLMs process web content, with the ability to diagnose technical issues (rendering, indexing, schema) independently.

  • Analyst Mindset: You are an expert data storyteller. You don't just provide numbers; you provide the "so what" and the "what's next."

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off & paid holidays

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $130,00 -$157,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicants knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

About the Role:

Crusoe is looking for a highly organized, proactive Real Estate Projects and Workplace Strategy Specialist to support our growing environment. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast paced environment, adapts quickly to shifting priorities, and enjoys building structure where it doesn’t yet exist.

You’ll support workplace and real estate initiatives including office buildouts, renovations, expansions, and space planning efforts. You’ll partner with internal stakeholders and external consultants to keep projects on track, manage key documentation, and support workplace planning needs as the company grows.

Space planning experience and CAD skills are required for supporting layout updates, test fits, and workplace planning documentation.

What You'll Be Working On:

  • Real Estate & Workplace Project Coordination

    • Support workplace and real estate projects including office buildouts, renovations, expansions, and restacks

    • Coordinate project schedules, meeting cadences, action items, and follow-ups across internal teams and external partners

    • Maintain project trackers, key milestones, and documentation across multiple workstreams

    • Support budget tracking, invoice coordination, and basic financial documentation for projects

    • Assist in preparing project updates, reporting, and stakeholder communications

    Space Planning & Workplace Planning Support

    • Support space planning initiatives tied to headcount growth, team needs, and evolving organizational requirements

    • Maintain and update floor plans, seating plans, and space allocation documentation

    • Support test fits and layout iterations in partnership with architects, designers, and internal stakeholders

    • Help ensure space plans align with workplace standards, planning assumptions, and future growth needs

    Vendor & Consultant Coordination

    • Coordinate with external partners including architects, space planners, engineers, contractors, and furniture vendors

    • Support RFP processes, vendor onboarding, and proposal coordination as needed

    • Help ensure project teams stay aligned on scope, schedule, deliverables, and decision-making timelines

What You'll Bring to the Team:

  • 4+ years of experience in project coordination, real estate, workplace strategy, design & construction, or a related field

  • Space planning experience (test fits, seating plans, adjacency planning, headcount planning support)

  • CAD skills (AutoCAD or similar) and/or experience updating floor plans and layouts

  • Experience supporting office buildouts, lease-related projects, or workplace scaling in a high-growth company

  • Familiarity with tools like Asana, Smartsheet, Monday, Jira, or similar project tracking systems

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects at once

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills and comfort working cross-functionally

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to create structure in evolving environments

  • Proficiency in Google Workspace (Sheets, Docs, Slides)

  • Adaptable and flexible: comfortable shifting priorities as business needs evolve

  • Proactive and self-directed: anticipates needs and follows through without heavy oversight

  • Strong judgment and ability to prioritize effectively in a fast-moving environment

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off & paid holidays

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $128,000 -$150,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicants knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.
