About This Role:

Crusoe Energy is seeking an accomplished and meticulous Receiving Lead to join our dynamic and fast-paced team. As the primary owner of the inbound material process, you will be responsible for the accurate, safe, and efficient receipt, inspection, and initial processing of all equipment and materials.

This role is critical for maintaining inventory accuracy and asset readiness while serving as the safety lead for material handling areas. The ideal candidate thrives in an agile environment where compliance and precision are key to supporting our vertically integrated manufacturing and power operations.

What You’ll Be Working On:

  • Receiving Process Ownership: Manage all aspects of the inbound dock, including schedule coordination, verifying shipments against Purchase Orders (POs), and ensuring 100% accuracy in the inventory management system.

  • Cycle Time Management: Maintain a dock-to-stock cycle time of 24 hours or better, ensuring all materials are logged, labeled, and routed correctly based on quality status.

  • Quality & Quarantine Coordination: Partner with the Quality team to manage inspections, RMAs, and nonconforming products, ensuring proper isolation to prevent contamination of active inventory.

  • Safety Leadership: Serve as the safety lead for receiving areas, enforcing lifting standards, PPE requirements, and equipment protocols to maintain zero safety incidents.

  • Equipment Training: Train and certify team members on forklift operation and overhead crane signaling, ensuring full compliance for all operators.

  • Inventory Readiness: Ensure a highly organized staging area using lane marking, FIFO rotation, and clean work zones to support immediate production needs.

  • Audit & Documentation: Track and maintain detailed, audit-ready records for all shipments, including packing slips, inspection findings, and nonconformance reports.

  • Continuous Improvement: Identify operational inefficiencies and lead at least two measurable process improvement initiatives per year using root-cause analysis.

  • Team Collaboration: Manage receiving personnel and collaborate with Procurement, Production, and Inventory teams to prioritize "hot" parts and resolve supplier discrepancies.

What You’ll Bring to the Team:

  • Education & Experience: Associate's degree or equivalent experience; extensive experience in a dedicated receiving, warehouse, or inventory control role is required.

  • Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of receiving procedures, inventory management, and material handling best practices.

  • Safety Commitment: Proven experience enforcing safety protocols and regulations (OSHA) in a warehouse or industrial environment.

  • Software Proficiency: High level of comfort using inventory management (ERP/WMS) and receiving software.

  • Leadership Traits: Ability to hold a team accountable to KPIs such as receiving accuracy (target ≥98%) and dock-to-stock cycle times.

  • Safety and Compliance: This position is designated a safety-sensitive position and/or is located in a safety-sensitive facility. Drug and alcohol program participation is required.

Bonus Points:

  • Previous experience in a manufacturing or energy-infrastructure environment.

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for data tracking.

  • Experience implementing Lean Manufacturing or 5S methodologies in a receiving dock setting.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off & paid holidays

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $33.32 - $37.02 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicants knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

About This Role:

Crusoe is seeking a Warehouse Lead: Structural & Building Materials to anchor our vertically integrated manufacturing facility in Brighton, CO. This role is the backbone of our fabrication process, managing the heavy-duty materials required to build the physical shells of our AI-optimized modular data centers.

You will oversee the flow of structural steel, specialized metal sheeting, and building envelope components, ensuring our fabrication teams have exactly what they need to meet production milestones. This role is critical to maintaining a lean, high-velocity manufacturing environment where safety and material precision are paramount.

What You’ll Be Working On:

  • Structural Material Inventory Management Oversee the intake and organization of large-scale structural components and bulk raw materials. Ensure all inventory is stored in safe, stable environments and maintained according to weight-load and stacking safety standards to prevent damage or material degradation.

  • Heavy-Duty Kitting & Schedule Alignment Lead the kitting process for structural assemblies and framing components. Ensure that production teams receive 100% accurate material packages, including all required hardware and sub-components, delivered in strict accordance with the Production Schedule.

  • Sub-Assembly & Cross-Functional Coordination Manage the flow of Work-in-Progress (WIP) structural units by working closely with Production and Engineering teams. Ensure that large-scale assemblies move seamlessly through the facility, from initial framing to final staging or shipping.

  • Technical Quality & Pre-Kitting Inspection Perform meticulous technical inspections of structural materials and hardware prior to kitting. Verify dimensions, material grades, and quantities against the Bill of Materials (BOM) to identify defects or discrepancies before they reach the assembly line.

  • ERP Data Integrity & Root Cause Analysis Maintain absolute accuracy within the ERP system for bulk and high-value structural items to prevent procurement delays. In the event of a variance (e.g., miscounted stock or missing kits), lead the root cause analysis to identify the failure point and implement corrective actions.

  • Procurement & Vendor Alignment Partner directly with the Procurement Department to coordinate vendor deliveries. Manage the intake of "Just-in-Time" (JIT) deliveries for large-volume orders to optimize yard/warehouse space and ensure production never stalls.

What You’ll Bring to the Team:

  • Experience: 6+ years of warehouse experience, specifically in heavy manufacturing or structural fabrication environments.

  • Technical Proficiency: Advanced experience with ERP/MRP systems for tracking high-volume raw materials.

  • Equipment Mastery: Current forklift certification; experience with side-loaders or overhead crane operation is a major plus.

  • Safety Leadership: Deep knowledge of OSHA standards for heavy material handling, rigging, and overhead load safety.

  • Physical Strength: Ability to lift 50 lbs and navigate a high-activity fabrication floor for 8+ hours daily.

  • Safety and Compliance: This position is designated a safety-sensitive position and/or is located in a safety-sensitive facility. Drug and alcohol program participation is required.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience specifically with steel fabrication shop workflows.

  • Rigging certification for crane operations.

  • Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing principles such as 5S or Kanban.

About This Role:

Crusoe is seeking a Warehouse Lead: Structural & Building Materials to anchor our vertically integrated manufacturing facility in Brighton, CO. This role is the backbone of our fabrication process, managing the heavy-duty materials required to build the physical shells of our AI-optimized modular data centers.

You will oversee the flow of structural steel, specialized metal sheeting, and building envelope components, ensuring our fabrication teams have exactly what they need to meet production milestones. This role is critical to maintaining a lean, high-velocity manufacturing environment where safety and material precision are paramount.

What You’ll Be Working On:

 - Structural Material Inventory Management Oversee the intake and organization of large-scale structural components and bulk raw materials. Ensure all inventory is stored in safe, stable environments and maintained according to weight-load and stacking safety standards to prevent damage or material degradation.

 - Heavy-Duty Kitting & Schedule Alignment Lead the kitting process for structural assemblies and framing components. Ensure that production teams receive 100% accurate material packages, including all required hardware and sub-components, delivered in strict accordance with the Production Schedule.

 - Sub-Assembly & Cross-Functional Coordination Manage the flow of Work-in-Progress (WIP) structural units by working closely with Production and Engineering teams. Ensure that large-scale assemblies move seamlessly through the facility, from initial framing to final staging or shipping.

 - Technical Quality & Pre-Kitting Inspection Perform meticulous technical inspections of structural materials and hardware prior to kitting. Verify dimensions, material grades, and quantities against the Bill of Materials (BOM) to identify defects or discrepancies before they reach the assembly line.

 - ERP Data Integrity & Root Cause Analysis Maintain absolute accuracy within the ERP system for bulk and high-value structural items to prevent procurement delays. In the event of a variance (e.g., miscounted stock or missing kits), lead the root cause analysis to identify the failure point and implement corrective actions.

 - Procurement & Vendor Alignment Partner directly with the Procurement Department to coordinate vendor deliveries. Manage the intake of "Just-in-Time" (JIT) deliveries for large-volume orders to optimize yard/warehouse space and ensure production never stalls.

What You’ll Bring to the Team:

About This Role:

As a Master Electrician with Crusoe’s Manufacturing team, you will be a key leader in ensuring the reliability and safety of our electrical systems. Your advanced expertise will be essential for overseeing the installation, repair, and maintenance of these systems, directly impacting the efficiency and safety of our manufacturing operations. You will leverage your deep understanding of electrical codes and best practices to interpret complex blueprints, troubleshoot challenging electrical issues, and implement innovative solutions. This role offers the opportunity to mentor other electricians, contribute to a dynamic team, and work with cutting-edge technology. The ideal candidate is a highly skilled and experienced Master Electrician with a proven track record of success, a commitment to safety, and a proactive approach to problem-solving. This is a full-time position.

What You’ll Be Working On:

  • Electrical System Oversight: Overseeing the installation of complex electrical systems in manufactured buildings, ensuring adherence to codes and specifications.

  • Troubleshooting & Repair: Diagnosing and resolving electrical problems, utilizing your deep expertise to implement effective and long-lasting solutions.

  • Preventative Maintenance & Optimization: Developing and implementing preventative maintenance programs for electrical systems to ensure their long-term reliability and optimize performance.

  • Code Compliance & Inspections: Ensuring all electrical work complies with relevant codes and regulations, and conducting inspections to verify adherence to standards.

  • Blueprint Interpretation & Planning: Interpreting complex electrical schematics and blueprints, and developing detailed plans for electrical projects.

  • Mentorship & Training: Providing guidance and mentorship to other electricians, sharing your expertise and contributing to their professional development.

  • Safety Leadership: Promoting a strong safety culture within the team, ensuring adherence to all safety requirements and OSHA guidelines.

  • Project Management: Managing electrical projects, including planning, resource allocation, and timeline management.

What You’ll Bring to the Team:

  • Master Electrician License: A valid and current Master Electrician license.

  • Extensive Electrical Experience: Significant experience as a Journeyman and Master Electrician, demonstrating a deep understanding of electrical systems and best practices.

  • Technical Expertise: Advanced proficiency in using a wide variety of electrician tools, techniques, and testing equipment.

  • Code Knowledge: Comprehensive knowledge of relevant electrical codes and regulations.

  • Leadership Skills: Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and train other electricians.

  • Problem-Solving Prowess: Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to tackle complex electrical challenges.

  • Safety Compliance: Adhering to all safety requirements and OSHA guidelines to maintain a safe working environment.

  • Communication Skills: Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, to effectively interact with team members, contractors, and other stakeholders.

  • Physical Capabilities: Ability to perform the physical demands of the role, including lifting, bending, and working in various positions.

  • Safety and Compliance: This position is designated a safety-sensitive position and/or is located in a safety-sensitive facility. Drug and alcohol program participation is required. Must be able to pass a background check.

  • Travel: Up to 100% travel depending on project needs, including overnight stays.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience in a manufacturing environment.

  • Experience with PLC programming or automation systems.

  • Certifications related to specific electrical systems or technologies.

  • Project management experience.

  • Experience with high-voltage systems.

  • Knowledge of NEC and other relevant standards.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off & paid holidays

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

Compensation:

Compensation will be paid in the range of $45 - $49/hr + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

About This Role:

Crusoe Energy is seeking an accomplished and proactive Shipping Lead to join our dynamic and fast-paced team in Arvada. This individual will take a strategic leadership role, responsible for scheduling, arranging, and coordinating complex logistics operations across the company, focusing on inbound freight and outbound deployment.

This role is critical for optimizing our transportation efficiency, owning carrier relationships, and providing leadership to the overall logistics staff. The ideal candidate possesses a strong background in transportation and supply chain management and thrives in an agile environment where cross-collaboration is the key to successfully deploying our modular data centers.

What You’ll Be Working On:

  • Strategic Dispatch & Transportation: Schedule and optimize the dispatch of equipment and materials. Manage freight agreements, selecting and negotiating with carriers to minimize risk and cost.

  • Route & Load Planning: Plan inbound and outbound routing and trailer optimization for multi-stop and high-volume deliveries.

  • Packaging Department Oversight: Lead the wrapping and packaging team to ensure all products are secure and presentation-ready. Implement best practices for pallet stability and load protection.

  • Carrier Performance: Evaluate carrier and supplier performance using KPIs such as on-time delivery rates, damage-free rates, and freight cost efficiency.

  • Logistics Leadership: Oversee all logistics functions, including shipping, receiving, and packaging. Manage personnel scheduling, performance, and development while promoting a safety-first culture.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Engineering, Procurement, and Quality to forecast equipment needs and coordinate complex deployment schedules.

  • Operational Excellence: Analyze logistics data to identify improvements in throughput and material flow. Lead Kaizen events and maintain 5S standards in shipping areas.

  • Compliance & Documentation: Ensure 100% adherence to DOT regulations and internal transport policies, maintaining audit-ready traceability for all shipments.

What You’ll Bring to the Team:

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Business Administration, or an equivalent field is required.

  • Experience: Extensive experience in logistics coordination and transportation management, preferably in the energy or heavy industrial sectors.

  • Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of freight modes (LTL, FTL, heavy haul, and international) and supply chain procedures.

  • Leadership & Problem Solving: Proven ability to lead teams, manage complex projects, and solve high-stakes logistical hurdles.

  • Metrics & Ownership: Demonstrated ability to design and build reports for KPI and OKR tracking and proven ownership of transport agreements.

  • Safety and Compliance: This position is designated a safety-sensitive position and/or is located in a safety-sensitive facility. Drug and alcohol program participation is required. Must be able to pass a background check.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience managing a departmental logistics budget.

  • Professional certification in logistics or supply chain management (e.g., CSCP, CLTD).

  • Direct experience with heavy haul equipment coordination and specialized permitting.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off & paid holidays

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Project or Program Management Skills: Exceptional project management, analytical, organizational, and communication skills to drive projects forward.

  • Customer and Change Management: Experience with customer management and communication, maintaining positive client relationships. Ability to lock scope, identify scope creep and manage change.

  • Advanced knowledge of manufacturing processes.

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off & paid holidays

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

About This Role:

Reporting to the Director of Quality, the Product Quality Manager - Contract Manufacturing & Supplier Quality is responsible for developing and leading a robust contract manufacturing and supplier quality management program. This role ensures that all sourced products, materials, and components meet Crusoe’s stringent quality standards while supporting the organization's growing strategic supplier requirements.

As a critical leader, you will drive continuous improvement across the contract manufacturing supply base, mitigate risks, and ensure compliance with industry regulations. You will serve as a key partner to the Senior Director of Program Management, the Director of Engineering, and executive stakeholders to maintain product integrity and operational efficiency.

What You’ll Be Working On:

  • Strategic Leadership: Define and execute a supplier quality vision and long-term strategy aligned with organizational goals and risk mitigation.

  • Supplier Management: Establish and maintain robust programs for supplier selection, development, monitoring, and performance scorecards.

  • Quality Systems: Implement incoming material reviews, CAPA processes, and traceability protocols to enable effective root cause analysis.

  • Standards & Compliance: Establish supplier quality systems consistent with ISO 9001 or similar standards and maintain compliance with regulatory requirements (such as UL 891).

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Procurement, Technology, R&D, and Operations to ensure suppliers meet specifications during volume ramps and resolve systemic process breakdowns.

  • Performance Tracking: Define and track KPIs for supplier quality, presenting data-driven insights and risk assessments to senior leadership.

  • Continuous Improvement: Promote a culture of quality and provide training to employees on process improvement and quality matters.

  • Risk Mitigation: Conduct assessments for critical suppliers and develop contingency strategies for quality-related supply chain disruptions.

What You’ll Bring to the Team:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality Management, or a related field.

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in supplier quality within a manufacturing/industrial environment, plus 5+ years in a leadership role managing team performance and development.

  • Technical Expertise: Advanced understanding of Supplier Quality best practices, contract manufacturing management, and the ability to evaluate technical supplier capabilities.

  • System Knowledge: Experience developing and implementing supplier scorecards, performance dashboards, and quality improvement roadmaps.

  • Soft Skills: Exceptional communication and negotiation skills with a proven ability to influence senior leaders and drive alignment across functions.

  • Operational Attributes: Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, manage conflict, and approve/disqualify vendors based on data-driven criteria.

  • Safety and Compliance: This position is designated a safety-sensitive position and/or is located in a safety-sensitive facility. Drug and alcohol program participation is required. Must be able to pass a background check.

Bonus Points:

  • Certified Quality Manager (CQM) or Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence (CMQ/QE).

  • Expertise in ISO 9001, UL 891, and Lean Six Sigma tools.

  • Direct experience developing and administering a full Quality Management System (QMS).

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off & paid holidays

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $99,750 - $114,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicants knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

About This Role:

The Product Quality Manager serves as the primary technical authority and guardian of build excellence for the facility’s high-stakes infrastructure solutions. This individual owns the entire quality lifecycle, overseeing the process from the initial receipt of raw materials to the final shipment of finished products. While primarily focused on the Modular Data Center (Spark) product line, the Lead also provides critical oversight for Power Distribution Centers and all other building products manufactured within the facility. This role balances technical leadership with people management, ensuring that complex integrated systems consistently meet rigorous internal and industry standards.

What You’ll Be Working On:

  • Strategic Leadership: Define and execute a comprehensive product quality vision and long-term strategy aligned with organizational goals, focusing on the scalable production of Mobile Data Centers and Power Distribution units.

  • Team Management: Direct and mentor the Receiving and Production QC inspection teams, fostering a high-performance culture and ensuring consistent application of inspection standards across all shifts.

  • Quality Systems: Manage and evolve the facility’s Quality Management System (QMS), implementing robust incoming material reviews, CAPA processes, and traceability protocols to enable effective root cause analysis.

  • Standards & Compliance: Serve as the technical authority for compliance with ISO 9001 and regulatory requirements (such as UL 891 and UL 9540); manage the facility’s Calibration Program for all specialized testing equipment and tooling.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Procurement, Engineering, and Operations to ensure all building products meet technical specifications during volume ramps and resolve systemic process breakdowns or design-to-build conflicts.

  • Performance Tracking: Define and track key KPIs for product quality—including Defect rates and non-conformance rates—presenting data-driven insights and risk assessments to senior leadership.

  • Continuous Improvement: Promote a site-wide culture of quality by leading Non-Conformance (NC) activities and providing technical training to employees on process improvement and quality matters.

  • Risk Mitigation: Conduct quality assessments for critical build phases and develop contingency strategies for quality-related disruptions to the "Spark" product line delivery schedule.

What You’ll Bring to the Team:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality Management, or a related technical field is preferred.

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in product quality within a heavy manufacturing or industrial environment, plus 2+ years in a leadership role managing team performance and development.

  • Technical Expertise: Advanced understanding of build quality best practices, structural/electrical inspection techniques, and the ability to interpret complex engineering blueprints and schematics.

  • System Knowledge: Proven experience developing and implementing Quality Management Systems (QMS), performance dashboards, and quality improvement roadmaps.

  • Soft Skills: Exceptional communication and negotiation skills with a proven ability to influence senior leaders and drive alignment between production and engineering functions.

  • Operational Attributes: Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, manage conflict on the shop floor, and make data-driven decisions or approve final product shipment.

  • Safety and Compliance: This position is designated a safety-sensitive position and is located in a safety-sensitive facility. Drug and alcohol program participation is required.

Bonus Points:

  • Expertise in ISO 9001, UL 891, and Lean Six Sigma tools (Green or Black Belt).

  • Direct experience administering a full QMS within the modular building or data center infrastructure industry.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off & paid holidays

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $99,750 - $114,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicants knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

About This Role: The Master Scheduler is a critical role responsible for establishing and meticulously managing the master production schedule within our dynamic manufacturing environment. This position requires close collaboration with various internal teams to proactively ensure that all projects are prepared for initiation and are completed according to established timelines. The Master Production Scheduler plays a key part in optimizing our production flow and meeting customer expectations. This is a full-time position.

What You’ll Be Working On:

  • Master Production Schedule Management: Create and diligently maintain the master production schedule to ensure continuous and efficient plant operations across multiple manufacturing locations. This schedule shall have details down to daily activities production forecast across all facilities and extrapolate out 12 weeks.

  • Resource and data analytics: Analyze resources, determine production rates and crunch data to ensure accurate resource allocated production schedules.

  • Report Generation: Create insightful scheduling reports to readily identify material shortages, potential customer shipment issues, and labor requirements.

  • Production Schedule Communication: Communicate the 3 week, and 12 week master schedule clearly and effectively with the Production Manager, Production schedulers and Project Managers. This includes leading production schedule review meetings, providing project status updates, and communicating any potential delays.

  • Proactive Issue Identification: Review the schedules and proactively identify potential workforce, materials, and shipping issues, communicating these to the leadership team.

  • Process Improvement: Continuously monitor, identify, and manage areas for improvements to the overall scheduling process.

  • Issue Resolution: Proactively help identify critical paths, resolve resource conflicts, address material availability challenges, and troubleshoot manufacturing issues

  • MRP System Analysis: Interface with MRP data (currently acumatica) to incorporate production rates, material availability and project timelines into the master schedule.

  • Cross-Departmental Collaboration: Drive strong cross-departmental cooperation between the procurement, materials management, and production departments to ensure the accuracy of lead times, current inventories, and warehouse levels to optimize order fulfillment.

What You’ll Bring to the Team:

  • Educational Foundation: Bachelor’s degree in engineering, data analysis, manufacturing, business or related field

  • Production Planning Experience: 7+ years of demonstrable experience in production planning/scheduling.

  • Data Analytical and Time Management Skills: Strong analytical, time management, and organizational skills. This job will demand the ability to consume large amounts of data and produce concise schedule reporting.

  • Code scripting: Ability to hard code into data programs such as google sheets using the Script application.

  • Communication Skills: Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills.

  • Computer Literacy: Solid computer literacy in MS Office and Google products (specifically Excel/Sheets) with a strong ability to learn new software applications quickly.

  • Scheduling program experience: Efficient in scheduling programs such as MS Project, Primavera P6, Monday.com or similar.

  • MRP/ERP Experience: Experience with software related to schedule and demand planning, preferably with Material Requirements Planning (MRP) or Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems (e.g., Acumatica, Oracle ERP, SAP, SAGE, Infor).

  • Learning Agility: Eagerness to learn with strong listening, critical thinking, and problem-solving abilities.

  • Self-Motivation: Highly motivated self-starter who consistently demonstrates professionalism and a willingness to take on additional responsibilities as needed.

  • Team Player Mentality: A strong team player who consistently demonstrates a positive attitude towards teammates and actively strives for continuous improvement in processes and delivery.

  • Manufacturing Knowledge: Proven manufacturing experience (ideally in metal or electrical manufacturing) with a solid understanding of material flow principles.

  • Physical Capabilities: Requires the ability to lift, lower, push, and pull merchandise of all sizes up to 50 lbs. Requires the ability to stand, walk, stoop, and bend for 8 hours or more daily. Requires constant use of arms, hands, fingers, eyes, legs, and back.

  • Safety and Compliance: This position is designated a safety-sensitive position and/or is located in a safety-sensitive facility. Drug and alcohol program participation is required. Must be able to pass a background check.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with Arena Simulation or other Industrial Engineering software programs.

  • Experience with automation programs such as MS Power Automate to automate time consuming tasks between programs.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off & paid holidays

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $129,000 -$148,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicants knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. About This Role:

The Field Services Manager is a critical leadership role responsible for the end-to-end success of our field operations, power distribution solutions, and logistics. You will provide strategic direction to field support units while ensuring that deployed equipment meets the highest quality and safety standards.

This role bridges the gap between manufacturing, engineering, and the customer site, requiring a blend of operational excellence, technical expertise, and a "white-glove" approach to customer satisfaction. You are the final link in the chain, ensuring that Crusoe’s modular infrastructure is commissioned and maintained to peak performance in the field.

What You’ll Be Working On:

  • Field Operations & Technical Oversight: Lead and coordinate field support groups in the installation, start-up, and commissioning of power distribution equipment. Includes field deficiency remediation and warranty resolutions.

  • Technical Strategy: Collaborate with Engineering and Product Management to address quality/warranty concerns and implement engineering change requests in the field.

  • Quality Assurance: Interpret complex electrical drawings, wiring diagrams, and power studies to ensure installed equipment is configured to precise specifications. Develop KPI, PI programs along with field checklists associated with L2 and L3 Cx test scripts.

  • Diagnostics & Repair: Oversee the use of specialized electrical test equipment to diagnose, program, and repair electro-mechanical assemblies.

  • Logistics & Warehouse Management: Establish rigorous tracking for all material entering and leaving warehouse locations. Lead cycle counts and manage receivers for all deliveries.

  • Logistics Coordination: Maintain an effective coordinated calendar for all logistic activities to and from the field, ensuring the production team receives materials accurately.

  • Safety Leadership: Strictly enforce company and site-specific safety regulations; ensure all field support units maintain a safe and tidy work environment.

  • Documentation: Ensure the completion of detailed field technical reports, safety documents, and quality findings within the Company Maintenance Management System.

What You’ll Bring to the Team:

  • Experience: Minimum of 5 years in construction support operations or electrical/mechanical field services, with a deep knowledge of power distribution equipment.

  • Education: 2-year Technical Degree or Associate degree preferred; or an equivalent combination of education and relevant training.

  • Technical Proficiency: Expert ability to read and interpret technical drawings, service manuals, and Bills of Material. Proficient in MS Office and mobile data entry.

  • Soft Skills: Ability to act as a strategic advisor to senior leadership while remaining "hands-on" with field teams. Exceptional communication and organizational skills.

  • Physical Requirements: Ability to lift/carry up to 40 lbs.

  • Mobility: Valid driver’s license and ability to travel needed

  • Safety and Compliance: This position is designated a safety-sensitive position and/or is located in a safety-sensitive facility. Drug and alcohol program participation is required.

  • Travel: Up to 100% travel depending on project needs, including overnight stays.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience managing field fleets and heavy equipment logistics.

  • Familiarity with specific power distribution brands (e.g., Schneider, ABB, Eaton).

  • Prior experience in the data center, renewable energy, or oil and gas sectors.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off & paid holidays

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $141,000 -$162,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicants knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. About This Role:

The Production Scheduler is responsible for establishing and managing the master production schedule, acting as the central heartbeat of our plant operations. You will work across several internal teams to ensure that projects are ready to be started, material availability is secured, and delivery deadlines are met.

This role is critical for optimizing project planning, execution, and controls. You will be the primary link between customer expectations and production availability, ensuring that our manufacturing facilities operate with maximum efficiency and minimal downtime.

What You’ll Be Working On:

  • Master Scheduling: Create and maintain the production master schedule to ensure continuous, 24/7 plant operations.

  • Project Alignment: Monitor customer orders and collaborate with Project Managers to align delivery expectations with real-time production capacity.

  • Constraint Management: Identify critical paths and proactively resolve resource conflicts, material shortages, and manufacturing bottlenecks.

  • Reporting & Analytics: Generate scheduling and materials reports to identify potential shipment issues, labor requirements, and inventory gaps.

  • System Integrity: Maintain accurate and up-to-date project data within the MRP system (Infor Visual Manufacturing).

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Lead daily, weekly, and monthly production review meetings with leadership, highlighting project status, delays, and workforce needs.

  • Operational Cooperation: Drive collaboration between Procurement, Materials Management, and Production to ensure lead times and warehouse levels are accurate.

  • Continuous Improvement: Monitor and manage the 90-day production outlook, identifying opportunities to refine the scheduling process and improve order fulfillment.

What You’ll Bring to the Team:

  • Education: High school diploma or equivalent required.

  • Experience: 3–5 years of experience in production planning, preferably within metal or electrical manufacturing environments.

  • Technical Skills: Solid computer literacy in MS Office and Google Workspace (specifically advanced Excel/Sheets); ability to learn new software quickly.

  • System Knowledge: Experience with MRP/ERP software (Oracle, SAP, SAGE, or Infor) is highly preferred.

  • Industry Understanding: Strong understanding of material flows and manufacturing processes.

  • Physical Requirements: Ability to lift/push/pull up to 50 lbs and stand/walk/bend for 8 hours or more daily.

  • Safety and Compliance: This position is designated a safety-sensitive position and/or is located in a safety-sensitive facility. Drug and alcohol program participation is required. Must be able to pass a background check.

  • Professional Attributes: A highly motivated self-starter with strong analytical skills and a "team player" attitude.

  • Safety and Compliance: This position is designated a safety-sensitive position and/or is located in a safety-sensitive facility. Drug and alcohol program participation is required. Must be able to pass a background check.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with ISO 9001:2015 quality management systems.

  • Specialized training in Lean Manufacturing or Six Sigma methodologies.

  • Advanced experience with Infor Visual Manufacturing.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off & paid holidays

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

About This Role:

Join Crusoe Energy as an Assembly Lead and spearhead the final assembly of our innovative manufactured products and components. You'll lead a dedicated team, ensuring every product is completed with precision, properly packaged, and expertly palletized for shipment. This role is crucial for maintaining our production flow and upholding our commitment to quality, as you'll meticulously review work orders to guarantee your team has all necessary resources, from hardware to in-house parts. You'll also play a key part in coordinating with other department leads to proactively prevent any material shortages. If you're a hands-on leader with a strong mechanical aptitude and a passion for operational excellence, this is the role for you. This is a full-time position.

What You’ll Be Working On:

  • Assembly Crew Leadership: Lead, train, and coach your assembly crew, fostering a high-performing and collaborative environment. Manage crew PTO and sick time to ensure optimal manpower and uninterrupted departmental operations.

  • Work Order and Material Verification: Meticulously review work orders to confirm the availability and accuracy of all required materials, including hardware, components, and in-house parts.

  • Product Labeling and Compliance: Oversee the review and proper installation of company logos, labeling, NEMA Ratings, and UL information on all finished products.

  • Production Schedule Coordination: Coordinate seamlessly with other department leads and the production manager to ensure production consistently meets required schedules.

  • Schedule Adherence and Communication: Ensure strict adherence to production schedules and communicate any changes promptly to internal teams, including Project Management and Sales, to maintain alignment.

  • Continuous Process Improvement: Drive continuous improvement initiatives within your work team, focusing on enhancing procedures, processes, and methods to ensure safety and quality in every task.

  • Work Area and Inventory Management: Maintain an organized work area, keep parts inventory accurate, and manage materials efficiently to proactively prevent production delays.

  • Team Resource and Backfill: Act as a flexible floater and vital resource, stepping in to backfill production team members when required to ensure continuous operational flow.

What You’ll Bring to the Team:

  • Mechanical Aptitude: Possess a high level of mechanical aptitude for understanding assembly processes and troubleshooting equipment.

  • Physical Capabilities: Ability to lift, lower, push, and pull merchandise up to 50 lbs, and to stand, walk, stoop, and bend for 8 hours or more daily.

  • Computer Operation: Requires constant use of arms, hands, fingers, eyes, legs, and back to efficiently operate computers and related equipment.

  • Communication Skills: Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, coupled with a strong attention to detail.

  • Drawing Interpretation: Ability to accurately check engineering drawings for assembly requirements.

  • Learning Agility and Problem Solving: Eager to learn with strong listening, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills to address operational challenges effectively.

  • Professionalism and Responsibility: A highly motivated self-starter who consistently demonstrates professionalism and willingly accepts responsibility for team outcomes.

  • Team Player Mentality: Proven ability to perform as a collaborative team player, consistently showing a positive attitude towards colleagues, and striving for constant improvement in processes and delivery.

  • Project Persistence: An abundance of patience to see complicated projects through to successful completion.

  • Drive for Improvement: A strong drive to identify, create, and continually improve systems and processes for enhanced efficiency and quality.

  • Safety and Compliance: This position is designated a safety-sensitive position and/or is located in a safety-sensitive facility. Drug and alcohol program participation is required. Must be able to pass a background check.

Bonus Points:

  • Licensed Forklift Operator.

  • Proficiency in crating and packaging products for shipment.

  • Knowledge of UPS and FedEx tracking systems.

  • Experience using Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) software; Infor Visual or Acumatica experience is a plus.

  • Solid computer literacy in MS Office and Google products.

  • ISO 9001:2015 experience.

  • Metal manufacturing experience.

  • Electro-mechanical experience.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off & paid holidays

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $30-35/hr + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicants knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

jobs.title: Real Estate Strategy Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

About This Role:

Crusoe is building the world’s favorite AI-first cloud infrastructure, powered by clean and renewable energy. We are seeking a Real Estate Strategy Manager to join our real estate team. In this leadership-track role, you will be involved in the end-to-end acquisition - development lifecycle for large-scale data center projects. You won't just analyze feasibility; you will architect the strategy for site selection, capitalization, and global expansion. This role acts as a bridge between finance, engineering, and external municipalities to ensure Crusoe’s physical footprint scales ahead of the AI demand curve.

Location: In-office 5 days per week in our San Francisco, CA, office.

What You’ll Be Working On:

  • Strategic Site Acquisition: Lead the identification and de-risking of high-scale data center sites, overseeing the evaluation of power capacity, fiber latency, and complex environmental/geotechnical constraints.

  • Capital & Financial Architecture: Oversee the development of sophisticated financial models for infrastructure-heavy assets. You will design capitalization strategies that leverage conventional project finance alongside innovative alternative sources.

  • Investment Committee Leadership: Present complex acquisition opportunities and return scenarios to senior leadership and the Board, providing data-driven recommendations on land value and infrastructure recovery.

  • Entitlement & Stakeholder Management: Act as a point of contact for city officials, utilities, and community stakeholders, navigating the high-stakes zoning and permitting processes required for global expansion.

  • Vendor & Execution Oversight: Manage RFP for consultants, ensuring technical specifications meet our "AI-first" infrastructure standards.

  • Market Intelligence: Drive the team’s understanding of macroeconomic trends, specifically power market volatility, to pivot development strategies in real-time.

  • Cross-Functional Integration: Partner with Energy and Cloud teams to ensure real estate assets are optimized for maximum "electron-to-token" efficiency.

What You’ll Bring to the Team:

  • Experience: 5–8+ years of experience in real estate development, infrastructure investment, or project finance (ideally with a focus on industrial or digital infrastructure).

  • Strategic Modeling: Expert-level financial modeling skills with the ability to structure complex deals and explain the "why" behind the numbers to executive stakeholders.

  • Execution Track Record: Proven experience navigating the entitlement and permitting process for large-scale, complex land use projects.

  • Leadership & Influence: A natural ability to lead cross-functional pods and influence external partners to move at "Crusoe speed."

  • Academic Background: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Real Estate, Engineering, or a related field; MBA or Master’s in Real Estate Development (MRED) is highly preferred.

  • Technical Tools: Mastery of Excel and PowerPoint; proficiency in GIS and project management software.

Bonus Points

  • Direct experience in Data Center development or large-scale Power/Utility infrastructure.

  • Experience with IPP (Independent Power Producer) energy development or grid-interconnection processes.

  • A deep network within the industrial real estate or energy sectors.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off & paid holidays

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $155,000 - $185,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicants knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

jobs.descriptionHtml:

About the Role:

As a Superintendent with Crusoe’s Manufacturing team, you will be a key leader in ensuring the reliability and safety of our electrical systems. Your advanced expertise will be essential for overseeing the installation, repair, and maintenance of these systems, directly impacting the efficiency and safety of our manufacturing operations. You will leverage your deep understanding of electrical codes and best practices to interpret complex blueprints, troubleshoot challenging electrical issues, and implement innovative solutions. This role offers the opportunity to mentor other electricians, contribute to a dynamic team, and work with cutting-edge technology. The ideal candidate is a highly skilled and experienced Master Electrician with a proven track record of success, a commitment to safety, and a proactive approach to problem-solving. This is a full-time position.

What You'll Be Working On:

  • Electrical System Oversight: Overseeing the installation of complex electrical systems in manufactured buildings, ensuring adherence to codes and specifications.

  • Troubleshooting & Repair: Diagnosing and resolving electrical problems, utilizing your deep expertise to implement effective and long-lasting solutions.

  • Preventative Maintenance & Optimization: Developing and implementing preventative maintenance programs for electrical systems to ensure their long-term reliability and optimize performance.

  • Code Compliance & Inspections: Ensuring all electrical work complies with relevant codes and regulations, and conducting inspections to verify adherence to standards.

  • Blueprint Interpretation & Planning: Interpreting complex electrical schematics and blueprints, and developing detailed plans for electrical projects.

  • Mentorship & Training: Providing guidance and mentorship to other electricians, sharing your expertise and contributing to their professional development.

  • Safety Leadership: Promoting a strong safety culture within the team, ensuring adherence to all safety requirements and OSHA guidelines.

  • Project Management: Managing electrical projects, including planning, resource allocation, and timeline management.

What You'll Bring to the Team:

  • Master Electrician License: A valid and current Master Electrician license.

  • Extensive Electrical Experience: Significant experience as a Journeyman and Master Electrician, demonstrating a deep understanding of electrical systems and best practices.

  • Technical Expertise: Advanced proficiency in using a wide variety of electrician tools, techniques, and testing equipment.

  • Code Knowledge: Comprehensive knowledge of relevant electrical codes and regulations.

  • Leadership Skills: Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and train other electricians.

  • Problem-Solving Prowess: Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to tackle complex electrical challenges.

  • Safety Compliance: Adhering to all safety requirements and OSHA guidelines to maintain a safe working environment.

  • Communication Skills: Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, to effectively interact with team members, contractors, and other stakeholders.

  • Physical Capabilities: Ability to perform the physical demands of the role, including lifting, bending, and working in various positions.

  • Safety and Compliance: This position is designated a safety-sensitive position and/or is located in a safety-sensitive facility. Drug and alcohol program participation is required. Must be able to pass a background check.

  • Travel: Up to 100% travel depending on project needs, including overnight stays.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience in a manufacturing environment.

  • Experience with PLC programming or automation systems.

  • Certifications related to specific electrical systems or technologies.

  • Project management experience.

  • Experience with high-voltage systems.

  • Knowledge of NEC and other relevant standards.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off & paid holidays

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

Compensation Range:

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $60.15 - $68.75/hr + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicants knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. About This Role:

Join Crusoe Energy as the Principal Electrical Engineer and serve as the department’s technical authority on power distribution, power protection, and switchgear design. In this high-impact role, you will define the engineering standards and technical strategy for our modular integrated electronics buildings and critical power infrastructure.

You will move beyond day-to-day drafting to architect robust power systems, solve complex protection coordination challenges, and lead the technical direction of the electrical engineering team. You will be the "go-to" expert for regulatory compliance (NEC, IEEE, UL) and the final approver for critical design decisions. While this is a technical leadership role, you will also mentor staff and senior engineers, driving a culture of technical excellence and precision.

What You’ll Be Working On:

  • Technical Authority & Strategy: Serve as the reigning SME for power distribution and switchgear design (low and medium voltage). Lead high-level system architecture to ensure reliability and selectivity for modular data centers and power distribution centers.

  • Code Interpretation & Compliance: Act as the final decision-maker on complex code interpretations, ensuring strict compliance with NEC (NFPA 70), UL 1558/1670/891/508A, and IEEE standards.

  • Advanced Power Systems Analysis: Perform and oversee critical power system studies, including Short Circuit, Coordination, Arc Flash, and Load Flow analysis.

  • Protection & Control: Design and validate complex protection schemes, selecting and configuring protective relays (SEL, ABB, etc.) to ensure optimal system reliability.

  • Critical Design Reviews: Conduct deep-dive technical reviews of designs produced by the engineering team, serving as the final quality gate before fabrication.

  • Leadership & Mentorship: Provide expert mentorship to Staff and Senior Electrical Engineers, elevating the team's technical capabilities and fostering future leaders.

  • Engineering Standards: Develop and maintain the department’s electrical design standards, specifications, and best practices to ensure consistency across all projects.

  • Cross-Functional Strategy: Partner with Manufacturing and Product Management to align technical capabilities with long-term business goals, driving innovation in modular power solutions.

What You’ll Bring to the Team:

  • Education & Licensure: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering (BSEE); Master’s degree (MSEE) with a focus on Power Systems and an active Professional Engineer (PE) license are strongly preferred.

  • Industry Experience: 10–15+ years of progressive experience in electrical engineering, specifically focused on switchgear design and modular infrastructure.

  • Switchgear Mastery: Deep understanding of switchgear construction, bus bracing, thermal management, and insulation requirements for both LV and MV equipment.

  • Protection Expertise: Demonstrated mastery of power protection theory, including symmetrical components, relay coordination, fault current, and arc flash mitigation techniques.

  • Strategic Leadership: Proven ability to lead technical teams through complex engineering challenges, providing authoritative direction and "first principles" problem-solving.

  • Communication: Exceptional ability to communicate complex electrical concepts to non-technical stakeholders, executive leadership, and customers.

  • Safety and Compliance: This position is designated a safety-sensitive position and/or is located in a safety-sensitive facility. Drug and alcohol program participation is required.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience representing organizations on technical committees (e.g., IEEE, NFPA, UL).

  • Extensive experience with EPlan or AutoCAD Electrical for schematic integration.

  • Experience with PLC/SCADA integration as it relates to power automation.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off & paid holidays

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $197,000 -$232,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicants knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

About This Role:

The Mechanical Receiving & Shipping Quality Inspector is a critical checkpoint in the lifecycle of our Modular Data Center (Spark) and Power Distribution Center (PDC) product lines. This individual is responsible for ensuring that all incoming structural and mechanical components meet precise engineering specifications and that every finished unit is structurally sound and defect-free before it leaves the facility. Operating with a high degree of technical accuracy, this role prevents non-conforming materials from entering production and ensures our global customers receive a world-class, ruggedized product.

What You’ll Be Working On:

  • Inbound Technical Inspection: Perform detailed mechanical inspections on incoming raw materials and sub-assemblies, including structural steel, HVAC units, custom enclosures, and heavy-duty hardware, ensuring they match PO requirements and engineering drawings.

  • Outbound Shipment Validation: Execute final inspections on finished Mobile Data Centers and PDCs, verifying structural integrity, paint/coating quality, weatherproofing, and ensuring all shipping bracing and loose-ship items are present.

  • Documentation & Traceability: Maintain meticulous digital records of all inspections, including material certifications (MTRs), dimensional reports, and shipping checklists to ensure 100% traceability for every unit built.

  • Non-Conformance Management: Identify, document, and "red tag" non-conforming mechanical parts. Assist the Quality Lead in root cause investigations and follow up on Corrective Action Reports (CARs) with vendors.

  • Precision Measurement: Utilize a variety of mechanical tools—including calipers, micrometers, weld gauges, and ultrasonic thickness testers—to verify tolerances on critical "Spark" components.

  • Cross-Functional Feedback: Partner with the Production and Shipping/Receiving teams to communicate quality trends, helping to refine loading procedures and material handling to prevent transit damage.

  • Standards Compliance: Ensure all mechanical inspections align with ISO 9001 standards and specific structural requirements for modular building codes.

  • Safety & Logistics: Monitor the safe handling of oversized mechanical components during the offloading and loading process to prevent structural fatigue or cosmetic damage.

What You’ll Bring to the Team:

  • Education: High School Diploma or GED required; Technical certificate or Associate’s degree in Mechanical Technology, Welding, or Quality Inspection preferred.

  • Experience: 3+ years of experience in mechanical inspection within a heavy industrial, aerospace, or modular construction environment.

  • Technical Expertise: Advanced ability to read and interpret complex mechanical blueprints, structural drawings, and 3D CAD models.

  • Tool Proficiency: Hands-on experience with precision manual measuring instruments and a solid understanding of Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T).

  • System Knowledge: Basic proficiency with ERP systems (for logging receipts/dispositions) and digital Quality Management software.

  • Operational Attributes: Physical ability to navigate large-scale data center units, including climbing ladders and inspecting chassis undercarriages.

  • Safety and Compliance: This position is designated a safety-sensitive position and is located in a safety-sensitive facility. Drug and alcohol program participation is required.

Bonus Points:

  • CWI (Certified Welding Inspector) or ASQ Mechanical Inspector certification.

  • Direct experience with NEMA enclosure standards or HVAC system mechanical integration.

  • Experience operating heavy equipment (forklifts/cranes) to assist in the movement and positioning of units for inspection.

  • Previous experience in a "Shipping/Receiving" role specifically for heavy industrial electrical equipment.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off & paid holidays

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $26.39 - $29.33 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicants knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

About This Role:

Join Crusoe Energy as a Manufacturing Engineering Manager and lead the team responsible for how our products are built. In this critical leadership role, you will oversee the manufacturing engineering department, driving the strategic optimization of our production facilities and processes for modular integrated electronics buildings and power distribution equipment.

You will be the operational counterpart to the mechanical and electrical engineering managers, ensuring that everything from complex switchgear to factory-built modular data centers is designed for manufacturability (DFMA) and transitions smoothly into high-volume production. The ideal candidate is a seasoned leader with a deep background in Lean and/or Six Sigma manufacturing, facility optimization, and team development in a fast-paced environment.

What You’ll Be Working On:

  • Team Leadership & Strategy: Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of manufacturing engineers. Oversee resource allocation across multiple production lines and NPI (New Product Introduction) projects to ensure production goals are met.

  • Production Strategy & Plant Optimization: Direct strategic initiatives to optimize plant layout, balance assembly lines, and maximize overall facility throughput.

  • CapEx & Equipment Strategy: Oversee project budgets and provide strategic direction on the procurement, installation, and commissioning of advanced manufacturing machinery and tooling.

  • Continuous Improvement: Champion a facility-wide Lean manufacturing culture (Value Stream Mapping, 5S, Kaizen); implement improvements to production methodologies to enhance safety, quality, and efficiency.

  • DFMA & Design for Excellence (DFx): Lead Design for Manufacturability and Assembly reviews with design engineering, focusing on cost reduction strategies and assembly simplification.

  • NPI Leadership: Own the manufacturing side of the NPI process, ensuring a seamless handover of production-ready 3D models from the design team to the factory floor.

  • Engineering Change Management: Oversee the implementation of Engineering Change Orders (ECOs), analyzing impacts on inventory, tooling, and labor to ensure smooth transitions.

What You’ll Bring to the Team:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Manufacturing, Mechanical, Electrical, or Industrial Engineering.

  • Industry Experience: 7–10+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing engineering within a heavy assembly, electromechanical, or engineered-to-order environment.

  • Leadership Mastery: 3+ years of direct experience in a supervisory or management role, with a proven track record of developing technical talent.

  • Technical Skills: Deep expertise in Lean manufacturing principles and proficiency with 2D/3D CAD software for reviewing plant layouts.

  • Fabrication Knowledge: Advanced knowledge of metals, materials, and fabrication methods (welding, mechanical assembly, busbar forming) used in power distribution equipment.

  • Communication: Ability to effectively negotiate and influence stakeholders across Sales, R&D, and Operations.

  • Safety and Compliance: This position is designated a safety-sensitive position and/or is located in a safety-sensitive facility. Drug and alcohol program participation is required.

Bonus Points:

  • Master’s degree in Engineering Management or Business Administration (MBA).

  • Six Sigma Black Belt certification.

  • Direct experience leading a greenfield manufacturing plant startup.

  • Professional Engineer (PE) license.

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off & paid holidays

About This Role:

Crusoe Energy is revolutionizing computing by harnessing stranded natural gas to power high-performance computing, creating a more sustainable future. As a Plant Maintenance Technician, you will play a crucial role in maintaining the reliability and uptime of critical manufacturing equipment. You’ll work closely with the Facilities Manager to ensure smooth facility operations and establish a robust preventative maintenance system.

You'll be involved in exciting projects, including the integration of equipment into a new production facility, as well as the development of corresponding maintenance procedures. The ideal candidate is a highly skilled plant maintenance technician with a strong understanding of high and low voltage systems, a proactive approach to problem-solving, and a commitment to safety.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Troubleshoot Electrical & Mechanical Issues: Diagnose and resolve complex electrical (high and low voltage) and mechanical problems on manufacturing and facility systems to minimize downtime. Troubleshoot CNC machines, PLCs, utility systems (compressed air, potable water, HVAC), and production equipment, escalating advanced automation/control issues when necessary.

  • Maintain Electrical & Utility Systems: Oversee the maintenance of power supply lines, electrical distribution systems, motors, generators, switches, control panels, circuit breakers, wiring, sensors, relays, and electronic components. Maintain facility utility systems and building equipment such as hoists, overhead doors, and industrial trucks.

  • Preventive Maintenance Program: Plan, schedule, and execute preventive maintenance activities using a CMMS, including parts purchasing and developing work instructions. Manage PM workloads, prioritize tasks, conduct routine inspections, and implement reliability improvements.

  • PLC, Controls & Electrical Diagnostics: Perform diagnostics and repairs on PLC systems, control panels, wiring, fuses, breakers, and circuits. Interpret schematics and manuals to ensure seamless machine operation.

  • Regulatory & Safety Compliance: Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local safety and environmental regulations. Maintain and enforce the Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) program and drive adherence to safety standards across maintenance activities.

  • Project Coordination & Support: Collaborate with vendors, Engineering, and Operations teams on system upgrades, new installations, and maintenance activities. Support project work and equipment installations, ensuring timely and effective execution.

  • Work Leadership: Work independently with minimal supervision, completing assigned tasks and troubleshooting issues to minimize production impact. Provide informal guidance and support to other Maintenance Technician personnel while collaborating with Facilities Manager and internal customers.

What You'll Bring to the Team:

  • Extensive Electrical Experience: 5+ years (10+ preferred) of experience in high and low voltage electrical systems in manufacturing, including installation, maintenance, and repair. Familiarity with city utilities, rotating machinery, air compressors, and CNC machinery is highly valued.

  • Electrical Code Knowledge: In-depth understanding of relevant electrical codes.

  • Equipment Proficiency: Skilled in using electrical testing equipment such as voltmeters, amp meters, and other diagnostic tools.

  • Safety Focus: A strong commitment to safety, with experience in Lockout/Tagout procedures and safety-sensitive environments.

  • Problem-Solving Skills: Excellent troubleshooting skills for diagnosing complex electrical issues.

  • Communication & Collaboration Skills: Strong ability to work with managers, peers, and vendors effectively.

  • Physical Capabilities: Ability to work in varied weather conditions, stand or sit for long periods, and lift up to 50 lbs.

  • Safety and Compliance: This position is designated a safety-sensitive position and/or is located in a safety-sensitive facility. Drug and alcohol program participation is required. Must be able to pass a background check.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with actively utilizing a CMMS, preferably UpKeep.

  • Experience in other building trades such as carpentry, HVAC, or plumbing.

  • Experience partnering with production and scheduling departments.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation

  • Restricted Stock Units

  • Paid time off & paid holidays

  • Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

  • Employer contributions to HSA account

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

  • Professional development & tuition reimbursement

  • Mental health & wellness support

  • Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

  • Cell phone stipend

  • 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

  • Volunteer time off

Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $30-35/hr + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicants knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
